truthBoundary: This preserves owner intent and strategic doctrine. It does not create present-tense capability, demand, customers, revenue, payment, delivery, retention, legal clearance, provider readiness, or deployment proof.
economicNorthStar: risk-adjusted cleared contribution profit per founder minute
ultimateGoal: A private, cloud-operated, evidence-first autonomous economic operating system that increasingly performs the work of the company itself, acquires customers, proves economics, fulfils, retains, learns, and self-improves while minimizing founder effort.

commercialResponsibility.founderRoleTarget: Only genuinely human-exclusive gates such as MFA, KYC, identity confirmation, new paid commitments, or legally required personal decisions.

parallelLoops.law: Revenue generation and self-improvement run continuously in parallel. Pre-customer engineering completion never freezes system evolution.

currentChampion.name: White-label Attribution Integrity + Lost-Booking Evidence Sprint
currentChampion.buyerHypothesis: US or otherwise legally approved agencies serving HVAC, plumbing, or electrical companies
currentChampion.portfolioBoundary: The champion is one current experiment, not the permanent definition of UberBond.

preparedTargetBoundary: Prepared targets are not contact authority, contacted leads, qualified conversations, customers, or revenue.
distributionGoal: paid media only after positive measured economics

freeFirstDoctrine.rule: Before paying for a provider or capability, search for an approved zero-cost or lower-cost eligible route with sufficient quality, authority, reliability, security, policy compatibility and switching economics.
freeFirstDoctrine.reinvestmentRule: Once positive economics are proven, spend legitimately and aggressively where incremental expected risk-adjusted cleared contribution exceeds marginal cost.
forbidden: misusing opt-in or transactional providers for prohibited cold outreach

capabilityGenomeGoal.law: Never collapse these layers or install random large counts for vanity. Discover broadly, activate narrowly, benchmark continuously, revoke or replace when evidence changes.

wallbreakerGoal: Failures must create information. Compile the wall, diversify solution families, falsify assumptions, execute bounded attempts, classify failure, acquire missing capabilities if warranted, and avoid blind identical retries.
modelProviderGoal: Route across legitimately configured models/providers by capability, cost, latency, privacy, health and task requirements without hiding actual serving identity, bypassing terms, or duplicating uncertain non-idempotent effects.
founderAbsenceGoal: Operate through durable cloud scheduling, queues, leases, checkpoints, receipts, reconciliation, recovery, health, circuit breakers, bounded budgets and exact exception reporting. Founder absence requires observed elapsed operation.
truthLaws: internal QA is not customer acceptance
antiAmnesiaLaws: Never redefine UberBond as the latest offer.
Never make the founder the permanent manual sales department after engineering completion.
Customer acquisition and economic proof remain UberBond responsibilities.
Revenue generation and self-improvement run in parallel.
Pre-customer engineering completion never means self-improvement stops.
Every material future conversation should be digested into repository-native memory.
A new repo-aware session should recover these goals without asking the owner to reconstruct them.
